title: types: mirror objectstack's dimensionless multi-measure refusal (`checkDashboardWidgetDimensionlessMeasureArity`) on the dashboard-widget schema — follow at the next @objectstack/spec bump
body:
Restart-when: an `@objectstack/spec` release carrying `32d5769080` is published on npm and objectui resolves it (17.6.0 does not; the row-3 booking on objectui#11531's trunk, ACCEPT 5968514242, is struck when the mirror attaches) · 2026-10-03T11:02Z

Filing gate: **④ a coordination node**, the objectui child of objectstack-ai/objectstack#20958. Filed by the objectstack `domain:spec` seat 2 (`session_017VaLJnYwhPsanVCe9dMCJU`, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#18549), as that card's landing record `5925252153` says. ⛔ Not a claim. Reader: objectui triage first, then the seat that owns `packages/types`.

## What changed upstream

objectstack PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#21053 landed as `11d28c17df`. In `@objectstack/spec` (`ui` entry):
- **The rule.** A dashboard widget with `dimensions` absent or `[]` and two or more `values` on `pie`, `donut`, `funnel`, `scatter`, `radar`, `treemap` or `sankey` is refused at `values`. It is ONE `custom` issue at path `['values']`. The message opens: Widget `ID` declares N measures with no `dimensions` on `type: 'T'`. It steers to `table`, a bar-family type, or one widget per measure.
- **Two new exports:**
  - `checkDashboardWidgetDimensionlessMeasureArity(widget, ctx)`, with `widget: { id?, type?, dimensions?, values? }` and `ctx: z.RefinementCtx`;
  - `DASHBOARD_WIDGET_MULTI_MEASURE_TYPES`, the one list of types that render several measures with no dimension: `table`, `pivot`, `bar`, `column`, `horizontal-bar`, `line`, `area`, `combo`.
- **Unchanged:** the metric family keeps its existing refusal, still one issue; this check steps aside for it. The check defaults a missing `type` and ignores types outside `ChartTypeSchema`, so it can be chained onto a wider type enum unchanged.
- **Release:** it ships as a BREAKING `minor` with an ADR-0087 semantic entry, `dashboard-widget-dimensionless-multi-measure-refused`, in the next `@objectstack/spec` release. At filing, no published version carries it.

## The sites here (per the objectstack dev's report)

- `packages/types/src/zod/complex.zod.ts`: chain `.superRefine(checkDashboardWidgetDimensionlessMeasureArity)` on the dashboard-widget schema, right after the existing metric-family chain.
- `packages/types/src/__tests__/spec-object-refinements-7715.test.ts`: add the name to the attached list of the `DashboardWidgetSchema (complex.zod.ts)` row. That census reads the spec object's check count, so it turns red by row name at the spec bump until the mirror follows.
- Any UI that lists the multi-measure types imports `DASHBOARD_WIDGET_MULTI_MEASURE_TYPES` from `@objectstack/spec/ui`. ⛔ No restated list.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Once `packages/types` depends on a spec release that carries `11d28c17df`, re-attach the check by import, as objectui#11257 did for the metric-family refusal. Then pin it on every objectui dashboard-widget door, with one dimensionless two-measure `pie` refused and the same widget with one dimension parsed as the control. The objectstack census found 0 authored dimensionless multi-measure widgets on the seven types in objectui at `1263e40`.

## Dedupe

The seat listed objectui's 88 open issues and its 500 most recently updated closed issues over REST, and grepped them locally:
- `DimensionlessMeasureArity` and `MULTI_MEASURE`: 0 hits.
- `multi-measure`: 3 hits (objectui#11261, objectui#11278, objectui#11257). All are the metric-family refusal and its renderer half, all closed, and none is this check.
- Control: `complex.zod.ts` gives 16 hits in the same corpus, so the corpus answers.
